title: Bootstrap Examples
description: Read and copy these small page parts. Add them to a page that loads Bootstrap 5 CSS. Follow the setup lesson first; this playground does not load Bootstrap for you.

examples.title: A reading button
examples.description: Use two classes to style one button. Add your own click action when your page needs one.
examples.output: A button with the main theme colour and the words Read a story.

examples.title: A second button style
examples.description: An outline can make a less important button look lighter than the main button.
examples.output: A button with a coloured border and the words Read later.

examples.title: A place for page content
examples.description: A container keeps a long page from becoming too wide on a large screen.
examples.code:
Reading club

Bring a book on Friday.
examples.output: A heading and a paragraph, with room above and below and a limited width on large screens.

examples.title: Two boxes that fit a phone
examples.description: These boxes stack on a small screen. From md upwards, each uses half of the row.
examples.code:
Story books
Fact books
examples.output: Two stacked boxes below 768px; two side-by-side boxes at 768px and wider.

examples.title: A book card
examples.description: A card keeps the title and short description of one book together.
examples.code:
Moon Trip

Two friends explore space.
examples.output: A bordered card with a title and a short description, with space inside.

examples.title: An opening paragraph
examples.description: Use a lead paragraph to give a short welcome message extra attention.
examples.code:
Our garden club

Plant a seed. Watch it grow.
examples.output: A heading followed by a larger opening paragraph.

examples.title: A labelled text box
examples.description: The label tells the reader what to type. Its for value matches the input id.
examples.output: A label reading Book title and a styled text box beneath it.

examples.title: Choose a book type
examples.description: A select box offers a short list of choices.
examples.output: A labelled select box with Story, Science and History as options.

examples.title: A clear reminder
examples.description: Say the message in words so everyone can understand it without relying on colour.
examples.code: Bring a notebook to the club on Friday.
examples.output: An information message box reminding readers to bring a notebook.

examples.title: A small count label
examples.description: A badge can show a short count next to a heading.
examples.output: A Reading list heading with a small coloured label saying 3 books.

examples.title: Keep two buttons apart
examples.description: A flex row puts the buttons together, and gap adds room between them.
examples.output: Two buttons in a row with a small gap between them.

examples.title: A card with dark colours
examples.description: Bootstrap 5.3 can give one part of a page a dark theme.
examples.code:
Evening reading

Pick a story for tonight.
examples.output: With Bootstrap 5.3 CSS, the card has dark surfaces and light text.
